name: Dwarves of Otaria and Sarpadia
description: Dwarves created by the Lady to defend her world, who worship her.

description_citations.text: "Lady of Otaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Demon despoilers attack the world and create goblins; with Fiers's help the Lady creates the dwarves.
timeline.quote: With the help of Fiers, the Lady then created the dwarves to defend her world.

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lady and dwarves defeat the evil but she is gravely injured; Gaea heals her and Fiers encases her in half her egg.
timeline.quote: The Lady and the dwarves defeat the evil, but the Lady is grievously injured in the process.

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sarpadian dwarves summon the Lady to evacuate them to Terisiare after their empire falls.
timeline.quote: The first time her name was used was by the Sarpadian dwarves to evacuate them from Sarpadia to Terisiare
